parsed.rationale_overall: System B references more specific user profile attributes (loss comfort 3/10, $22,000 emergency goal, $3,800 expenses, 5-7 year house goal) and ties recommendations directly to those values, while System A relies more on generic debt-paydown framing. System B also provides more concrete, executable steps (specific account types, monthly surplus calculations, ticker alternatives like VMFXX/SPAXX) without making the unsupported '15-25% debt interest' assumption that System A introduces.
